lyrics:
[Intro: harpsichord-like electric piano arpeggio, soft strings]

[Verse 1: low, dark, almost spoken]
Got my father's forehead and my mother's frown
Got a map of every time I let me down
Somebody's been drawing while I slept
A ledger of the promises I kept

[Verse 2: bass and soft drums enter]
There's a crease for every winter that I worked
There's a crease for every answer that I shirked
And the laughing made the ones around my eyes
I wouldn't sell them back at any price

[Chorus: band rises, guitars enter, voice higher]
These are lines I earned
Every one a bridge I burned or built
I'm not smoothing out a single year
Count them, I'm still here
Go on, count them
I'm still here

[Verse 3: fuller, voice with more edge]
Half my heroes never got this far
Half my friends are pictures in a drawer
So I'll take the grey and I'll take the ache
I'll take every morning I can wake

[Chorus: band rises, guitars louder, voice higher]
These are lines I earned
Every one a bridge I burned or built
I'm not smoothing out a single year
Count them, I'm still here
Go on, count them
I'm still here

[Build: one phrase repeated, each time higher, drums pounding]
Still here
Still here
Still here
Still here
Still here
Still here

[Climax: screamed at the top of the range, full band, strings]
Still here
Still here

[Outro: arpeggio returns alone, slowing]
Count them
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 80 BPM, 4/4, F minor. A slow, grave march that keeps climbing. Dark, proud and finally ferocious.

VOICE: Male. He starts in a low, husky, almost spoken register, darker than his natural voice. Each section moves higher and harder. In the build he repeats two words, rising a step each time, until he is screaming them in a piercing, raw upper register that few singers can reach.

INSTRUMENTS: An electric piano with a plucked, harpsichord-like sound playing a baroque arpeggio. A string-machine pad (the wavering, tape-like strings of early 1970s rock). Electric guitars that enter quietly and grow to thick, sustained chords. A melodic bass. A drum kit that begins softly and ends pounding. A short guitar lead before the build.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the arpeggio and strings. 0:24 Verse 1. 0:48 Verse 2, bass and drums. 1:12 Chorus 1. 1:42 Verse 3. 2:06 Chorus 2. 2:36 Build, the two words repeated six times, each a step higher. 3:12 Climax, screamed twice over the full band. 3:36 Outro, the arpeggio alone, slowing, two quiet words at 4:05.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-1970s hard rock with a classical tint: warm, slightly murky and analogue, the keyboard and strings wide, the voice dry.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first full scream at 3:12.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: A teenager wrote the original imagining age. This is written from inside it: friends in a drawer, grey hair accepted, and pride in the evidence. The scream is not despair. It is a roll-call answered.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Inventory, defiance, a roar of presence.
